title: Anicca user profile
description: Single source of truth for per-user PERSONAL DATA (non-secret). Secrets (API keys/tokens) live in .env, NEVER here. Raw payment cards are NEVER stored — only processor tokens. This file is gitignored; ship identity/profile.example.json as the template. Skills READ from here (e.g. profile.{{profile.lateness.stakeholders.toField}}); only the anicca-config skill WRITES here, validated against this schema.

{{profile.lateness.stakeholders.senderTy.description: Legal/real name — use ONLY for official docs (graves, government, contracts).

languages.description: BCP-47-ish codes in priority order, e.g. ["ja","en"].

homeAddress.description: Base address for travel-time calculations (calendar booking).

workEmail.description: Day-job {{profile.lateness.stakeholders.channel}}. Skills must read this — NEVER hardcode it.

reportPlatform.description: Where Anicca posts its diary/heartbeat reports.

reportChannel.description: Platform-specific channel id (e.g. Slack channel C0XXXXXXXXX).

notifyEmail.description: Where urgent/nudge mails go if reportPlatform != {{profile.lateness.stakeholders.channel}}.

work.description: Day-job constraints so Anicca never books over them.

calendarBase.description: Address travel time is computed from (often = identity.homeAddress).

education.description: Generalized: ANY school. Lets a school-specific skill (e.g. naist-*) work for any student who fills this.

social.description: Per-platform accounts. Postiz/Blotato integration IDs are account references (not secrets) — fine to keep here; API KEYS stay in .env.

purpose.description: What this account is for, e.g. "JA slideshow (focus)".

goals.description: North-star / mission anchors the heartbeat re-reads each beat.

payment.description: NEVER store raw card/PAN/CVV. Only processor tokens/ids (PCI-safe).

stripeCustomerId.description: Stripe customer id (cus_...) — card data lives at Stripe, not here.

payoutStripeAccountId.description: Stripe Connect account id (acct_...) for payouts.
